subject.title: fix(feishu): pace outbound sends per target

question: Should this Feishu pacing PR require redacted live Feishu behavior proof before merge, or may maintainers accept the mocked send-seam proof for the new `sendRateLimit.minIntervalMs` config?
rationale: The code shape is plugin-local and plausible, but the PR adds an operator-facing delivery-timing config and the only proof is mocked; maintainer intent is needed on the proof bar and public config acceptance.

options.title: Require Live Feishu Pacing Proof
options.body: Ask for redacted live Feishu logs, terminal output, recording, or an artifact showing same-target pacing and distinct-target independence before merge.

options.title: Accept Mocked Seam Proof
options.body: Maintainers can explicitly accept CI and mocked runtime-seam proof, but that owns the risk that live Feishu timing behaves differently.

options.title: Pause For Config Direction
options.body: Pause or replace the PR if the Feishu owner wants a different key name, default, or pacing scope before making the config public.

recommendation.title: Require Live Feishu Pacing Proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted live Feishu logs, terminal output, recording, or an artifact showing same-target pacing and distinct-target independence before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The package metadata names this handle as the community-maintained Feishu/Lark plugin owner candidate for Feishu-specific config and send behavior.
